title: HEM-Med: A Hierarchical Agentic Memory Framework for Safe Multi-Center Medication Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2610.20191v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Medication recommendation (MR) is critical for clinical decision support. While existing MR methods are mostly designed for single-center learning, where only one independent hospital is involved, multi-center MR with hospitals of different scales has become increasingly demanding in practice. In multi center settings, abundant data from large medical centers can improve recommendation performance for low-resource centers. Despite a few preliminary attempts on this task, two critical gaps remain. Gap 1: Existing multi-center methods fail to disentangle transferable cross-hospital clinical experience from hospital-specific prescribing patterns, limiting clinical feasibility and physician acceptance. Gap 2: They commonly overlook multi label safety constraints of MR, including drug-drug interaction risks and local formulary feasibility, which are essential for safe real-world deployment. translated_title: HEM-Med：一种面向安全多中心用药推荐的分层智能体记忆框架
translated_abstract: 用药推荐（MR）是临床决策支持的关键环节。现有的用药推荐方法大多针对单中心学习设计，即仅涉及一家独立医院；而在实践中，涉及不同规模医院的多中心用药推荐需求日益增长。在多中心场景下，大型医疗中心的丰富数据可以提升低资源中心的推荐性能。尽管已有一些针对该任务的初步尝试，但仍存在两个关键缺口。缺口一：现有的多中心方法未能将可迁移的跨医院临床经验与医院特异的处方模式解耦，限制了临床可行性和医生的接受度。缺口二：这些方法普遍忽视了用药推荐的多标签安全约束，包括药物-药物相互作用风险和本地处方集可行性，而这些对于安全的真实世界部署至关重要。为解决这些缺口，我们提出了HEM-Med，一种新颖的...
tldr: HEM-Med提出了一种分层智能体记忆框架，通过将可迁移的跨医院临床经验与医院特异性处方模式解耦，并纳入药物相互作用等多标签安全约束，实现安全的多中心用药推荐。
en_tdlr: HEM-Med proposes a hierarchical agentic memory framework that disentangles transferable cross-hospital clinical experience from hospital-specific prescribing patterns while incorporating multi-label safety constraints such as drug-drug interactions, enabling safe multi-center medication recommendation.
